_comment: GOLEM-SKIN GAUNTLETS' bonus is DYNAMIC (+1/+0 for EACH Equipment attached to it), the first equipment bonus in the pool that is not a constant. Pins the arithmetic at the one place it is summed, EquipBonusFor: a 2/2 Sram wearing 2 Bone Saws (+1/+0 each) and 1 Gauntlets counts THREE attached Equipment, so the Gauntlets grants +3 (it counts ITSELF -- it is attached to that creature) and the attack is 2+2+3 = 7. The one-pass form (sum of scalers x count) is what makes this exact for multiple scalers; the naive per-equipment recount would be O(n^2) at the hottest helper in the engine. A constructed board because the pruned search does not reliably stack three specific Equipment on one host by turn 3.
